newsitem.title: USA: Textron to give more capital to Paul Revere.
newsitem.headline: Textron to give more capital to Paul Revere.

text.p: Textron Inc and Provident Companies Inc said Wednesday they agreed Textron will provide additional capital to its 83 percent owned subsidiary, The Paul Revere Corporation.
They said the companies will make certain other adjustments relating to Provident's pending acquisition of Paul Revere.
They said the transaction is targeted to close early in the first quarter of 1997.
As a result of the revised agreement, Textron said it will recognize an additional loss from discontinued operations in the third quarter of $155 million, net of tax.
These amended results have been released separately by Textron.

On April 29, 1996, Provident announced a definitive agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Paul Revere. Pursuant to the revised agreement, the financial terms of Provident's acquisition of Paul Revere are unchanged to Paul Revere's public shareholders, said a statement released by Textron and Provident.
